title: report.requested (v1)
description: ResearchOrchestrator instructs ReportAgent to compose the final honest Report from the frozen ResearchMemory (and optionally the original ResearchSpec). ReportAgent's Report-writing mode is M14 -- this is the frozen contract only; no consumer wired yet.

research_memory_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen ResearchMemory object to report on.

research_spec_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the original ResearchSpec, or null if not provided.

citation_audit_report_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the CitationAuditReport (EvidenceAuditAgent Mode C), or null if not provided.

result_ref.description: Frozen selected executable result, including a valid negative result.
